author: ViceTechnicolour
body:
Hey,

This is a message to all map developers and thriving mapmakers of Avicus. The event committee is currently in need of DTM/CTW (Destroy the Monument/Capture the Wool) maps with the sole purpose of being played in the tournament. We're looking for what you all would want in a tournament map, and any feedback regarding this is welcome. We are also opening submissions for players to submit their own maps to us for the tournament. Put [TM] in the title of your post behind or in front of the map name.

Keep in mind this is HEAVILY RELIANT on gameplay and will be tested thoroughly. If you are open to making a tournament map, please touch base in this thread and if you finish one, post it on the "Map Releases" section. The event committee wants to phase this out to make the tournament happen.

You are welcome to use any features of Minecraft you want, TNT is encouraged and redstone is welcome. I ask the following however; please do not have your map be flat or laggy. Please do not coat it with too many aesthetics and don't add any overpowered chests, if you are caught adding OP chests a punishment may be issued. 

Thanks for sticking around with us! Please post any questions below in this thread.

replies.body:
Imo, Cherryland and Clay Wars would be great Tourney Maps. 

Cherryland: TNT would need to be used in scrims well and would be used for Icarus' and cannons, putting some OCN-esque. gameplay on the table, and some pretty nice defences could be set up as well on the map. 

Maybe edit spawn and move the supply chests near spawn to avoid early cannons blowing up all the other team's resources early and basically giving the team who's resources are gone, no way to retaliate. 

Clay Wars: Takes Coordinated team pushes to get to the monument and monuments are just hard to push in general. Good defences could be set up and would be a very good push/hold and control-oriented map.  

Maybe add water, as I feel this map could be about skybridge control.

just some maps I feel would be good as tournament maps
